issues.title: Refactor complex logic to TypeScript
issues.body:
The use of TypeScript helps with development and maintenance of SERGE.

It probably isn't justified to move all `js/jsx` code over to `ts/tsx` versions.  But, we should focus on ones that contain lots of logic.  One such example is `GameSetupNew.jsx`

We should use some command line script to find the larger `js`/`jsx` files - and concentrate on porting these.

Other large js/jsx files here:
* `wargames_ActionCreators.js`
* `messages_ActionCreators.js`
* `wargames_Reducer.js`
* `messages_api.js`
* `GameSetupNew.jsx`
* `*Tab.jsx`

Separate to places where complex logic would be more reliable with TS, there are occasions when a versatile method uses `any` to allow a range of input objects. These objects aren't covered by type-checking. We should modify them to give more control/checking:
* DeleteModal
* hmm, I'm sure there are others.
